name: proseguit
description: PROSEGUIT - Sistema de Gestión de Inventario IT

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run generate --workspace=backend && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run generate --workspace=backend && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run generate --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run generate --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=backend
